Same Likert self-report metacognition scale (full text). Subclaim rewritten to students rating themselves higher on every indicator; entry names the self-report scale; claim retitled.

Full text: randomised, but all three outcomes are self-report scales (Communicative Adaptability Scale, I-ADAPT-M, Resourcefulness Scale). Retitled to self-reported communication, adaptability and resourcefulness; subclaim and entry say so; q3 kept.

Full text: empathy and knowledge rest on weekly teacher feedback and interviews at one school within the wider Bullying Prevention Pack. Retitled to 'Teachers reported that role-plays and discussions fostered empathy and knowledge'; dropped the vocabulary/metacognition/credited-reduction wording; entry already said reported perception.

Senior-strand teacher feedback only (full text); bullying reduction came from OBVQ-R self-reports in two non-random schools and is no longer in the title. Entry now says empathy and knowledge are teachers' reports within the wider BPP; claim retitled.

Full text says participants were 'assigned' to feedback groups; random assignment is never reported. Entry no longer says randomly assigned, q3 -> q2 (frontmatter and header too). Full text: randomised wait-list trial, every secondary outcome a self-report questionnaire (mindful action = FFMQ Act with Awareness); authors list self-report reliance as a limitation. Retitled to self-reported well-being skills; subclaims and entry say self-report; q3 kept.

Full text: end-of-study learner focus groups only, no earlier focus group or comparison, no knowledge test. Retitled to focus groups 'said they understood' and reported confidence; both subclaims and the entry now say self-reported with no pre-intervention or comparison measure.

Full text: 'learning outcomes' is a 2-item 5-point self-rating of understanding, motivation a 4-item self-report ARCS scale, fixed-order within-subjects design, and CT disposition measured not manipulated. Retitled to students with stronger disposition reporting higher motivation and self-rated understanding; subclaim and entry say associations and self-rating, no test.

Full text: random assignment between two versions confirmed, but declarative knowledge was first measured post-intervention (T1, T2) with no untreated control, so 'both versions raise' is unsupported. Retitled to versions leaving equal knowledge that declined; entry and subclaim state no pre-measure or control; q3 kept for the version comparison.

WWC report: SSRS Academic Competence is a nine-item teacher estimate of reading/math performance, motivation, intellectual functioning and parental support. Retitled to teacher-rated academic competence; subclaim and entry say teacher ratings, not a test; RCT and q3 kept.

Abstract only (paywalled): compares pre-existing high and low achievers; no assignment possible for achievement level. Entry no longer says 'Experimental study', now a non-randomised comparison of pre-existing groups whose difference is an association; q3 -> q2 (frontmatter, header, subclaim). Title was already descriptive.
